explanation: R58 is accepted as an accurate fail-closed blocked result, but P57 is not successful. Independent inspection confirmed a continuous ledger of 5 inherited plus 27 new outbound attempts, 11 provider-reached requests, 16 preconnect failures, zero quota, zero retained records for both topics, no completed live rounds, no MTC, no fixture, no Registry V3, no PR and no merge. Official TikTok oEmbed proved only that a known stable URL/ID can be verified; it did not establish compliant topic discovery. The exact implementation diff is nine authorized evidence/test/doc paths, protected blobs remain unchanged, targeted P57/Foundation checks pass, and an independent rerun of the exact CI deterministic list at head 6eecaa4208b67aea29781d90d87ecf12ddb55868 passed 56/56. Continuing requires new Human authority because the 40-new-attempt ceiling cannot satisfy further discovery plus two verification rounds.

blocker_assessment.primary_blocker: No compliant reproducible topic-to-canonical-video discovery surface was established.
blocker_assessment.secondary_blocker: Sixteen preconnect failures consumed the attempt-based budget before the candidate batch reached TikTok.
blocker_assessment.why_more_of_same_is_not_preferred: Additional blind public-surface attempts may consume budget without solving topic discovery; the known oEmbed surface verifies only already-known URLs.
decision_options: Authorize a revised bounded recovery using a reliable canonical-URL discovery input or an official approved API with separately authorized credentials.
Authorize a vetted paid/public data provider after legal, terms and spending review.
Accept external_blocked and continue the overnight run without TikTok.
